Commentary.Commentary: That is all from this game. The series is set up nicely for the big event. It's 1-1 right now and the winner takes it all. The third and final T20I is on the 14th of this month at 11.30 am GMT. Do join us earlier for the build up. Till then, cheers!

Rashid Khan says Darwish Rasooli played an impressive knock and is also happy with how they bowled. Mentions they need to play more cricketing shots and it's crucial to play according to the conditions as once you adopt, it gets easier to bat. On Darwish Rasooli, he says they were searching for someone who can bat at number 4.
Darwish Rasooli wins the PLAYER OF THE MATCH AWARD.

Sikandar Raza says their batting is an Achilles-hills and gives them problems while scoring runs. Adds he was happy with the start from the openers but didn't capitalize after the Powerplay. Shares bowling and fielding was fantasitc from them as compared to the firs game but is disappointed not get over the line. Tells they need to play well in all three departments against a team like afg and they need to turn the ship around to win the series.

A comfortable win for Afghanistan and they level the series. Afghanistan didn't had enough runs to defend but were impressive with the ball. Naveen-ul-Haq to start in the Powerplay along with Azmatullah Omarzai. Mujeeb Ur Rahman in his spell of four overs took two wickets but the spin magician, Rashid Khan was at his best once again. He was unplayable today and scalped three wickets.
